cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Places, vehicles and journeys; words that look alike (bus, coach, tram, train; road, street, motorway) get clearly different pictures.

words.en: The airport is very big.
words.scene: A modern airport building with big glass windows, a passenger plane on the ground in front of it, and Lily pulling a suitcase towards the door with Dad.
more: Dad drives us to the airport.
爸爸开车送我们去机场。
Our plane leaves the airport at nine.
我们的飞机九点离开机场。

words.en: The plane goes up into the sky.
words.scene: One white passenger plane flying high in a blue sky with soft clouds, its wings, engines and tail clearly shown.
more: We travel by plane to Spain.
我们坐飞机去西班牙。
Look, a big plane in the sky!
看，天上有一架大飞机！

words.en: Our flight is at seven in the morning.
words.sz: 我们的航班在早上七点。
words.scene: A big passenger plane lifting up at the end of a long runway, its nose high in the early morning sky, green grass beside the runway.
more: The flight takes two hours.
这个航班要两个小时。
Our flight to Spain is quick.
我们去西班牙的航班很快。

words.en: We fly to Spain in July.
words.sz: 我们七月坐飞机去西班牙。
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting side by side in their seats inside a plane, looking out of a round window at the wing and white clouds.
more: Mum flies to London on Monday.
妈妈星期一坐飞机去伦敦。
Tom likes flying in a plane.
Tom 喜欢坐飞机。

words.en: The pilot flies our plane.
words.scene: A grown-up woman pilot in her thirties in a dark blue uniform with gold stripes and a pilot's cap sitting in a plane cockpit with many buttons, clouds outside the window.
more: The pilot says hello to us.
飞行员和我们打招呼。
Lily wants to be a pilot.
Lily 想当飞行员。

words.en: A red helicopter is in the sky.
words.sz: 天上有一架红色直升机。
words.scene: One red and white helicopter in the air above green fields, its long round blades turning, a pilot visible in the front window.
more: The helicopter comes down on the hill.
直升机降落在小山上。
That helicopter is very loud.
那架直升机很吵。

words.en: Mum shows her passport.
words.scene: Mum holding up a passport (no writing) at the airport
more: Where's your passport, Dad?
爸爸，你的护照在哪儿？
Our passports are in the bag.
我们的护照在包里。

words.en: Our luggage goes on the plane.
words.scene: a pile of bags and suitcases on an airport trolley
more: Dad carries the heavy luggage.
爸爸提着很重的行李。
Where is our luggage?
我们的行李在哪儿？

words.en: Lily's suitcase is big and red.
words.sz: Lily 的行李箱又大又红。
words.scene: Lily pulling a big red suitcase on wheels at the airport
more: Dad puts the suitcase in the car.
爸爸把行李箱放进汽车里。
I pack my clothes in my suitcase.
我把衣服装进行李箱里。

words.en: Dad has a small brown case.
words.sz: 爸爸有一个棕色的小箱子。
words.scene: Dad carrying a small brown case on a station platform
more: Our case is under the seat.
我们的箱子在座位下面。
This case is heavy!
这个箱子很重！

words.en: Lily wears her backpack on the trip.
words.sz: Lily 旅行时背着她的背包。
more: Sam has a green backpack.
Sam 有一个绿色的背包。
Put the map in your backpack.
把地图放进你的背包里。

words.en: Mum has the tickets for the train.
more: Where's your ticket, Dad?
爸爸，你的票在哪儿？
We show our tickets on the bus.
我们在公共汽车上出示车票。

words.en: Every passenger has a seat.
words.sz: 每位乘客都有一个座位。
words.scene: passengers sitting in their seats on a train
more: The passenger next to Mum is kind.
妈妈旁边的乘客很和善。
Tom is a happy passenger.
Tom 是个快乐的乘客。

words.en: I have a seat next to Tom.
words.sz: 我有一个座位，在 Tom 旁边。
words.scene: One blue train seat by a window, with a small folded table beside it and a bag on the seat.
more: Tom sleeps in his seat.
Tom 在他的座位上睡着了。
Please take a seat, Mum.
妈妈，请坐。

words.en: Our journey takes five hours.
words.sz: 我们的旅程要五个小时。
words.scene: Lily looking out of a train window at mountains on a long journey
more: The journey by train is long.
坐火车的旅程很长。
We sing songs on the journey.
我们在旅途中唱歌。

words.en: We go on a trip to the beach.
words.scene: The family in the car with a beach ball, buckets and spades on the back seat, driving along a coast road, the sea and a sandy beach ahead.
more: Dad plans a trip for Sunday.
爸爸为星期天安排了一次出行。
The trip to Grandma's is short.
去奶奶家的路不远。

words.en: We take a tour of the old castle.
words.sz: 我们参观了那座古老的城堡。
words.scene: the family walking round an old castle with a map
more: The tour of the museum is fun.
参观博物馆很有趣。
Grandma joins our tour at two.
两点钟奶奶加入我们的参观。

words.en: We travel by train to London.
words.scene: the family with backpacks looking at a big map of the world
more: I like travelling with my family.
我喜欢和家人一起旅行。
Mum loves to travel by boat.
妈妈喜欢坐船旅行。

words.en: That tourist takes a photo.
words.scene: A grown-up man tourist in his forties in shorts and a sun hat taking a photo with a camera in front of a big old castle, a map in his pocket.
more: There are many tourists here in summer.
夏天这里有很多游客。
The tourist asks Dad for help.
那位游客向爸爸求助。

words.en: Our tour guide is very kind.
words.scene: a tour guide holding up a small flag, leading a group of tourists past an old castle
more: The tour guide shows us the old castle.
导游带我们看那座古老的城堡。
Dad talks to our tour guide.
爸爸和我们的导游说话。

words.en: Mum asks at the tourist information centre.
words.sz: 妈妈在游客问讯处问路。
words.scene: a small bright office with maps on the walls, a smiling woman helping a family (no writing)
more: The tourist information centre is near the station.
游客问讯处在车站附近。
We get a map at the tourist information centre.
我们在游客问讯处拿了一张地图。

words.en: We visit Grandma on Sunday.
words.scene: Lily and Tom visiting Grandma, hugging her at her door.
more: Lily visits her friend Mia.
Lily 去拜访她的朋友 Mia。
We visit the old castle in the morning.
我们上午参观那座古老的城堡。
senses: Our visit to the museum is fun.

words.en: Every visitor likes the dinosaur.
words.sz: 每位参观者都喜欢那只恐龙。
words.scene: visitors looking at a big dinosaur in a museum.
more: The museum is full of visitors on Saturday.
博物馆星期六满是参观者。
Who is that visitor at the door?
门口那位访客是谁？

words.en: We go to school by bus.
words.scene: a red town bus at a bus stop.
more: The bus comes at eight.
公共汽车八点钟来。
Dad waits for the bus in the rain.
爸爸在雨里等公共汽车。

words.en: We meet Dad at the bus station.
words.sz: 我们在公共汽车总站和爸爸碰面。
words.scene: a big bus station building with many buses parked in rows.
more: The bus station is next to the railway.
公共汽车站就在铁路旁边。
Mum buys our tickets at the bus station.
妈妈在公共汽车站买我们的票。

words.en: We wait at the bus stop.
words.sz: 我们在公共汽车站的站牌那儿等。
words.scene: Lily and Mum waiting at a bus stop pole by the road, no bus there yet.
more: The bus stop is near our school.
公共汽车站的站牌就在我们学校附近。
Tom runs to the bus stop.
Tom 跑到公共汽车站的站牌那儿。

words.en: We go to London by coach.
words.sz: 我们坐长途大巴去伦敦。
more: Our coach stops at the petrol station.
我们的长途汽车在加油站停一下。
The coach is big and blue.
这辆长途汽车又大又蓝。
senses: We go to London by coach.

words.en: Our train is at nine o'clock.
words.scene: One long green train with many windows travelling fast through the countryside, Lily and Tom visible in the windows.
more: The train is slow today.
火车今天很慢。
We see the sea from the train.
我们从火车上能看到大海。
senses: Sam trains with his football team.

words.en: Our train is on platform four.
words.sz: 我们的火车在四号站台。
words.scene: Lily and Grandpa standing on a long platform as a train arrives.
more: Mum waits for us on the platform.
妈妈在站台上等我们。
Be careful on the platform, Tom.
Tom，在站台上小心点。

words.en: The railway goes over a tall bridge.
words.sz: 铁路从一座高桥上通过。
words.scene: a long railway line through green hills, a train far away.
more: We walk beside the railway line.
我们沿着铁路边走。
The railway station is very old.
那个火车站很老了。

words.en: Dad meets us at the station.
words.scene: a big old railway station building with a clock.
more: Our train leaves from this station.
我们的火车从这个站开。
The station is near our hotel.
车站就在我们旅馆附近。

words.en: We go to the city by underground.
words.scene: an underground train arriving in a station under the city.
more: The underground is fast in London.
地铁在伦敦很快。
Mum looks at the underground map.
妈妈看着地铁图。
senses: Ants live in an underground home.

words.en: The tram goes slowly along the street.
words.sz: 有轨电车沿着街道慢慢开。
words.scene: a modern tram on rails in a city street.
more: Lily says hello to the tram driver.
Lily 向有轨电车司机问好。
We get off the tram near the park.
我们在公园附近下电车。

words.en: Mum calls a taxi for us.
words.sz: 妈妈给我们叫了一辆出租车。
words.scene: Mum getting into a yellow taxi (no writing).
more: We go home by taxi at night.
我们晚上坐出租车回家。
The taxi driver knows the way.
出租车司机认得路。

words.en: The bus driver says hello.
words.sz: 公共汽车司机和我们打招呼。
words.scene: A grown-up man bus driver in his forties with a moustache and a blue uniform shirt sitting at the big steering wheel of a bus, passengers sitting behind him.
more: Dad is a careful driver.
爸爸是位小心的司机。
The taxi driver helps Mum with the bags.
出租车司机帮妈妈拿行李。

words.en: We go to Grandma's by car.
words.scene: the family getting into their small blue car in front of their house, bags in the back seat.
more: Dad washes the car on Sunday.
爸爸星期天洗车。
Tom sleeps in the back of the car.
Tom 在汽车后座睡着了。

words.en: The red motorbike is very fast.
words.scene: A shiny red motorbike parked on a quiet street, a grown-up rider in a black leather jacket putting on his red helmet beside it.
more: Our neighbour has a big motorbike.
我们的邻居有一辆大摩托车。
The motorbike is very loud.
那辆摩托车声音很大。

words.en: The car engine is very loud.
words.sz: 汽车发动机的声音很大。
words.scene: an open car bonnet showing the engine, Dad looking in.
more: Dad starts the engine.
爸爸发动了发动机。
Be careful. The engine is hot.
小心，发动机很烫。

words.en: We need petrol for the car.
words.scene: Dad filling the car with petrol from the pump.
more: Dad puts petrol in the car.
爸爸给汽车加汽油。
The petrol here is expensive.
这里的汽油很贵。

words.en: Dad stops at the petrol station.
words.scene: A petrol station at the side of a road, Dad standing beside the family car filling it with petrol from a green pump, a small shop behind.
more: The petrol station is next to the bus station.
加油站就在公共汽车站旁边。
We buy milk at the petrol station.
我们在加油站买牛奶。

words.en: We keep our bikes in the garage.
words.sz: 我们把自行车放在车库里。
more: Dad opens the garage door.
爸爸打开车库门。
Max sleeps in the garage.
Max 在车库里睡觉。

words.en: The mechanic helps Dad.
words.scene: A grown-up man mechanic in his thirties in blue overalls with oil on his hands, kneeling and changing a car wheel in a garage, tools on the floor.
more: The mechanic changes our tyre.
修理工给我们换轮胎。
Our mechanic works in a garage.
我们的修理工在车库里工作。

words.en: Lily wants to be an engineer.
words.scene: A tall grown-up woman engineer about forty years old with grey streaks in her hair, in a white hard hat and an orange vest, standing on a big new bridge and checking a large plan; workers behind her.
more: Sam's aunt is an engineer.
Sam 的姑妈是工程师。
An engineer looks at the old bridge.
一位工程师在查看那座老桥。

words.en: Dad repairs Tom's bike.
words.sz: 爸爸修 Tom 的自行车。
words.scene: Dad repairing Tom's small red bike with tools in the garage, Lily holding a wheel
more: Mum can repair the old bike.
妈妈会修那辆旧自行车。
Can you repair my toy car?
你能修一下我的玩具汽车吗？

words.en: Our car has a new tyre.
words.sz: 我们的汽车有一个新轮胎。
words.scene: Dad pumping up a car tyre
more: Look, Dad is changing the tyre.
看，爸爸在换轮胎。
The bike tyre is small.
自行车的轮胎很小。

words.en: Dad puts a new wheel on the car.
words.sz: 爸爸给汽车装上一个新车轮。
words.scene: One big black car wheel standing on the garage floor, with Dad kneeling next to it
more: Lily's bike has two big wheels.
Lily 的自行车有两个大轮子。
This toy car has four wheels.
这个玩具汽车有四个轮子。

words.en: Dad checks the oil in the car.
more: The mechanic puts oil on the chain.
修理工给链条上油。
Tom helps Dad with the oil.
Tom 帮爸爸拿油。

words.en: Dad has a new driving licence.
words.scene: Dad proudly holding up a small card with his photo (no writing)
more: Where is Mum's driving licence?
妈妈的驾照在哪儿？
Mum is learning for her driving licence.
妈妈在为她的驾照学习。

words.en: Dad drives us to school.
words.scene: Dad sitting in the driving seat of the family car, both hands on the steering wheel, Lily and Tom in the back seat
more: Mum drives to work every day.
妈妈每天开车去上班。
We drive to Grandma's on Sunday.
我们星期天开车去奶奶家。

words.en: The park is near our hotel.
words.sz: 公园就在我们旅馆附近。
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Sam playing football on the green grass of a park, big trees and a duck pond behind them, Max running after the ball.
more: We walk through the park to the station.
我们穿过公园去车站。
There is a big tree in the park.
公园里有一棵大树。

words.en: We park the car near the beach.
words.sz: 我们把汽车停在海滩附近。
words.scene: Dad parking the family car carefully in a parking space outside a shop, reversing between white lines, Lily and Mum waiting on the pavement.
more: Don't park the car by the road.
别把汽车停在路边。
Mum can park the car here.
妈妈可以把汽车停在这里。

words.en: The road goes through the fields.
words.scene: A country road going between green fields, the family car driving along it and Lily looking out of the window
more: The road to the beach is long.
去海滩的路很长。
Dad drives slowly on the country road.
爸爸在乡间小路上开得很慢。

words.en: The street is full of shops.
words.scene: a busy town street with shops on both sides
more: Lily crosses the busy street with Mum.
Lily 和妈妈过那条繁忙的街道。
Our school is on this street.
我们的学校在这条街上。

words.en: The motorway is very wide.
words.scene: a wide motorway with many lanes of cars, seen from a bridge
more: Dad drives on the motorway to London.
爸爸走高速公路去伦敦。
Look, the motorway is full of cars.
看，高速公路上满是汽车。

words.en: Dad goes round the roundabout.
words.scene: cars driving round a roundabout with flowers in the middle, seen from above
more: The roundabout has flowers in the middle.
环岛中间有花。
Is there a roundabout near the station?
车站附近有环岛吗？

words.en: There is a lot of traffic today.
words.scene: a long line of cars in a busy street, Tom looking out of the car window
more: The traffic is slow on the motorway.
高速公路上的车流很慢。
Tom watches the traffic from our window.
Tom 从我们的窗户看车流。

words.en: The traffic light is red.
words.scene: a traffic light showing red, cars waiting, Lily and Mum waiting to cross
more: Wait at the traffic light, Tom.
Tom，在红绿灯前等一等。
The traffic light is green. We can go.
红绿灯是绿的，我们可以走了。

words.en: Our train goes over a tall bridge.
words.sz: 我们的火车从一座高桥上通过。
words.scene: A long stone bridge over a wide river, a green train going across it, Lily watching from the grass
more: The bridge is next to the station.
那座桥就在车站旁边。
Is that bridge old, Dad?
那座桥很旧吗，爸爸？

words.en: Dad looks at the map.
words.scene: A big open paper map with red and grey lines for roads and green for fields, no writing, Lily and Dad looking at it beside their car
more: Where is the beach on the map?
地图上海滩在哪儿？
Lily holds the map for Dad.
Lily 帮爸爸拿着地图。

words.en: Is this the way to the beach?
words.scene: Lily standing where two country paths meet, holding an open map, Dad behind her, the sea far away
more: Which way do we go, Mum?
妈妈，我们走哪条路？
We ask the way at the shop.
我们在商店问路。

words.en: Turn left at the bridge.
words.scene: Dad on a bike at a corner, his left arm out, turning left, Lily following.
more: Mum sits on the left in the car.
妈妈坐在汽车里的左边。
Tom sits on my left.
Tom 坐在我左边。

words.en: Is this the right way to the station?
words.scene: The teacher putting a big red tick on Lily's answer, Lily smiling.
more: We are on the right bus.
我们坐对了公共汽车。
Dad takes the right road home.
爸爸走对了回家的路。

words.en: Turn right at the shop.
words.scene: Mum and Tom walking on a pavement turning right at a corner, Mum pointing right.
more: Tom walks on Mum's right.
Tom 走在妈妈的右边。
Our hotel is on the right.
我们的旅馆在右边。

words.en: Is the station far?
words.scene: Lily standing on top of a green hill, pointing at a tiny town far away on the other side, a long thin road between them.
more: Our school is not far from here.
我们学校离这儿不远。
The castle is very far away.
那座城堡非常远。

words.en: The train leaves at ten.
words.scene: The family walking out of their front door with suitcases and backpacks, Dad locking the door behind them, Max sitting by the steps.
more: What time do we leave, Dad?
爸爸，我们几点出发？
We leave home at seven in the morning.
我们早上七点离开家。

words.en: We return home on Sunday.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Mum getting off the train at their own station with their bags, Dad waiting on the platform with Max.
more: Grandma returns to her village by bus.
奶奶坐公共汽车回她的村子。
Mum buys a return ticket to London.
妈妈买了一张去伦敦的往返票。
senses: Mum buys a return ticket to London.

words.en: We move to a new house.
words.scene: Dad carrying a big brown box up the steps of a new house while Lily pushes a small trolley with her toys and Tom laughs beside Mum.
more: Don't move, Tom! Max is under the box.
别动，Tom！Max 在箱子下面。
Sam moves his toys into his new room.
Sam 把他的玩具搬进他的新房间。

words.en: The bus stops here.
words.scene: A yellow bus stopped at the side of the road with its door open, Lily and Mum getting on with their small bags.
more: Is this our stop, Mum?
妈妈，这是我们的站吗？
Dad stops the car and we get out.
爸爸停下车，我们下车。

words.en: There is a long delay at the station.
words.scene: A crowded station platform, a grown-up man in a suit looking at his watch and sighing, a woman sitting on her suitcase, Dad, Mum and Tom waiting, the train tracks empty.
more: The delay is two hours.
延误了两个小时。
The rain delays our train.
下雨让我们的火车晚点了。

words.en: Our flight is delayed.
words.scene: Lily sitting on her red suitcase at a big airport window, looking bored, a plane waiting outside in the rain.
more: The train is delayed again.
火车又晚点了。
The bus is delayed, so we are late.
公共汽车晚点了，我们迟到了。

words.en: Hurry up! Don't miss the train.
more: I miss Grandma when she goes home.
奶奶回家后我很想她。
Don't miss the boat, Sam!
Sam，别错过船！

words.en: The sky is light in the morning.
more: Turn on the light, Mia.
把灯打开，Mia。
Dad reads in the light from the window.
爸爸在窗边的光线下看书。
senses: Lily has a light blue dress.

words.en: Mum buys a ticket at the machine.
words.scene: Lily watching Mum buy a train ticket from a tall ticket machine on the platform, no writing anywhere on it, only buttons and a small screen with coloured shapes.
more: The machine gives Dad his ticket.
那台机器把票给爸爸。
Look, Sam puts money in the machine.
看，Sam 把钱放进机器里。

words.en: Lily looks in the mirror.
words.scene: Lily standing in front of a big mirror in the hall, her coat on and her bag over her shoulder, ready for a trip, her smiling self in the glass.
more: Tom makes a funny face at the mirror.
Tom 对着镜子做鬼脸。
Dad puts on his hat in front of the mirror.
爸爸在镜子前戴上帽子。

words.en: Lily looks out of the train window.
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting side by side on a train seat, looking out of the big open window at green fields and hills going past.
more: Can I sit by the window, Dad?
爸爸，我能靠窗坐吗？
Mum opens the car window.
妈妈打开汽车的车窗。

words.en: Can we go by boat, Grandpa?
more: The small boat crosses the lake.
那条小船穿过湖面。
We take a boat to the island.
我们坐船到那座岛上去。

words.en: We see a big ship at sea.
words.sz: 我们在海上看到一艘大船。
words.scene: One big white ship with a tall funnel on the blue sea, small waves around it, Lily and Tom waving from the sand of the beach in front.
more: The ship goes to France in eight hours.
这艘船八个小时到法国。
Dad watches the ship from the beach.
爸爸在海滩上看那艘船。

words.en: We go sailing on Saturday.
more: Sailing needs a lot of wind.
玩帆船需要很多风。
Lily learns sailing at the lake.
Lily 在湖边学玩帆船。

words.en: Sam gives Lily a ride on his bike.
words.sz: Sam 让 Lily 骑他的自行车。
more: Dad takes Tom for a ride in the car.
爸爸带 Tom 坐汽车兜风。
Can we ride our bikes to the station?
我们能骑自行车去车站吗？

words.en: The explorer draws a map.
words.sz: 那位探险家画了一张地图。
more: The explorer walks into the forest.
探险家走进了森林。
Do you want to be an explorer, Lily?
Lily，你想当探险家吗？

words.en: We travel to another country.
words.sz: 我们到另一个国家去旅行。
more: Which country do we fly to?
我们坐飞机去哪个国家？
We drive to the country on Sunday.
我们星期天开车去乡下。
senses: We drive to the country on Sunday.

words.en: The ambulance comes fast.
words.scene: A white ambulance with its lights on driving along a road, no writing anywhere on it, Dad waving it in from the side, Lily and Tom standing with Mum on the pavement behind a low fence.
more: Listen! An ambulance is coming.
听！救护车来了。
An ambulance helps sick people.
救护车帮助生病的人。
